d:
Short-cropped, charcoal black hair with a sharp, military parting and coarse texture. Narrow, piercing amber-gold eyes with a stern, calculating expression. Apparent age in the mid-thirties with a weathered, mature face. A broad, muscular build with an imposing physical presence. Signature heavy plate armor in polished silver and deep cobalt blue, accented by a high-collared mantle. Wears a thick leather belt with a gold buckle and carries a heavy, ornate steel broadsword.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
